description: Source code for USB-C VBUS ADC driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing VBUS measurement, level checking, discharge, and enable functions with device initialization.

methods.name: adc_vbus_measure
methods.description: Reads VBUS voltage in mV, scaling if necessary.

methods.name: adc_vbus_check_level
methods.description: Checks if VBUS is at a specified level (safe 0V, present, removed).

methods.name: adc_vbus_discharge
methods.description: Sets GPIO pin to discharge VBUS.

methods.name: adc_vbus_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables VBUS measurement via GPIO.

methods.name: adc_vbus_init
methods.description: Initializes the ADC VBUS driver, configuring GPIOs and ADC channel.
